Definition: Eliel, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliel is the name of nine Israelites. In 1 Chronicles 5:24, the text says "and Eliel."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliel matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
